answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 54 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. The fable register is checked at draw time, horizon lists the eligible set, and ripple seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 54 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker pays for every seat it wants. Honest users pay that once, farms 40 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
